title: The link of fragile memory to recurrence awaits neural evidence

statements.text: Whether fragile visual short-term memory is carried by recurrent processing is not yet shown. Its few-second lifetime suggests a reverberating cortical process, but neurophysiological measures have to confirm it.

sources.quote: Still, neurophysiologic measures will have to confirm this link.
Preliminary data provides some indirect evidence for this, by showing a cortical origin and a long-lasting, reverberating nature.
